row:
The University of Worcester is a campus-based university in a beautiful English cathedral city. It's a place where every individual is supported to achieve their potential.

Worcester has become so popular with students because we have: An outstanding record of graduate employment; High-quality teaching; Professionally-focused courses; Excellent student support; A green and peaceful campus in a historic city.

This really is a very special place to study.
